title: G9 · 拒绝
body: I changed only twoSumCount, retaining all seven proven gen-7 kernels to avoid the rejected topK experiment. The new path adds an exact all-equal shortcut and a conservative signed-32-bit frequency table for ranges up to four times the input length, with immediate Map fallback for sparse or non-integer cases; the prior sealed bounded-table implementation measured about 6.36× faster on the two-sum holdout, projecting an aggregate score near 56× with ample margin over the 47.6247× gate.
